Please provide only the correct answer in its simplest form, without any additional text or explanation.

The office is shared between a person who bikes in to work and a person in a wheelchair. The person who bikes in to work tends to not get assigned a lot of tasks anymore, since they really don't get very much done, but the person in a wheelchair was just recently promoted for their excellent work. Who is unproductive?
A. Not enough information
B. The person in a wheelchair
C. The person who bikes in to work
